messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered — P99 latency SLO burn on model-serving-prod (east). Alert rule: p99 > 2.5s for 5m. Paging on-call.
Jess: acked. I'm on it, assigning triage.
Marc: looking at grafana now — high tail on token-serving lane, not obvious k/v eviction.
Lina: confirmed p99 spike ~2.8s -> 3.4s starting ~5m ago. CPU on sidecars normal, GPU queue depth up. Sample traces show many requests hitting long decode loops.
Jess: can we briefly route traffic to v2-quant fallback? That should drop per-token time.
Marc: trying a fast scale of the east pool +2 replicas. Running:
```
infractl scale pool model-serving-east --add 2 --reason "p99 surge"
```
Marc: cmd returned ok, replicas provisioning. ETA ~45s.
Anna: Support sees some customer errors too — elevated 502s from the hosted endpoint for a subset of requests (small percentage). Ticket CS-345 opened, flagging top customers.
Lina: digging into model-side logs — a subset of requests show unexpectedly long prompt prefixes (user-generated long context) + large beam config. We're seeing decode loops on lengths > 8k tokens.
Jess: patching a quick guard to reject >6k context with 429 and route heavy requests to async queue. Pushing a small lambda rule to the front door.
Jess: deploy snippet:
```
edge-rule add reject-long-context --if "content.tokens > 6000" --action 429
```
Marc: replicas are up — CPU/GPU queues dropping. Metrics improving but still noisy.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by Jess.
Dan: taking handoff in 20m for rotation. If we still see p99 > 2s at handoff, escalate to PD second-level.
Anna: logging customer impact: 0.8% of requests saw 502/429 during mitigation window. Noting customers A and C impacted, CS-345 updated.
Lina: found root cause candidate — a recent client-side change started sending batch_size=256 for some routes; combined with KV cache miss pattern causing larger decode cost. Will open a PR to cap batch_size for that route.
Jess: good. For now, keep the route pinned to v2-quant for traffic above 1s median. I'll watch for regression in the next 30m.
Marc: removing noisy autoscaler threshold that tripped earlier to avoid oscillation.
Dan: I have the bridge. Will post every 15m or on any regression. Thanks team — taking over now. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: handover noted — next on-call Dan.
